description: Single-panel line plot (no sub-panels) of strain hardening rate versus true stress. The y-axis is "Strain Hardening (GPa)", linear from 0 to 5 in 1 GPa steps; the x-axis is "True Stress (MPa)", linear from 400 to 1800 in 200 MPa steps. Two curves are plotted: black = "8Al-450°C/1h", red = "8Al-600°C/24h", with the legend printed inside the lower-left of the frame; a horizontal black dashed line runs across the plot at roughly 2.05 GPa. The black curve begins off-scale above the 5 GPa top edge at true stresses below ~550 MPa, falls steeply to a minimum just below 2 GPa near 550–600 MPa, recovers to a plateau of ~2.1 GPa from ~800 to ~1150 MPa, then descends to ~0.9 GPa and terminates near 1500 MPa. The red curve enters the frame at the 5 GPa top edge near 1100 MPa, drops to ~1.9 GPa around 1200 MPa, rises to a broad maximum near 2.2 GPa at ~1350 MPa, then falls to ~1.2 GPa at ~1550 MPa. Both annealed 8Al steels therefore display a single, nearly constant hardening regime close to 2 GPa, with the 600 °C/24 h sample sustaining hardening to higher true stress before it collapses.

observations.observation: The figure is a single unlabelled-panel line plot with y-axis "Strain Hardening (GPa)" spanning 0–5 (ticks every 1 GPa) and x-axis "True Stress (MPa)" spanning 400–1800 (ticks every 200 MPa).

Two curves are drawn and labelled in an in-frame legend: a black curve for 8Al-450°C/1h and a red curve for 8Al-600°C/24h; the corresponding sample names are also annotated in matching colours inside the plot area.
A horizontal black dashed reference line is drawn across the plot at approximately 2.05 GPa.

The black 8Al-450°C/1h curve is off-scale above the 5 GPa top edge at low true stress (below ~550 MPa), drops steeply to a minimum just below 2 GPa at roughly 550–600 MPa, then plateaus at ~2.1 GPa between ~800 and ~1150 MPa.
The black 8Al-450°C/1h curve falls from the plateau region to ~0.9 GPa and terminates at a true stress near 1500 MPa.
The red 8Al-600°C/24h curve enters the frame at the 5 GPa top edge near 1100 MPa, drops to ~1.9 GPa near 1200 MPa, then rises to a broad maximum near 2.2 GPa at about 1350 MPa.
The red 8Al-600°C/24h curve terminates at ~1.2 GPa near a true stress of 1550 MPa, i.e. at higher stress than the black curve.
Both curves show a single hardening regime that stays close to 2 GPa over a wide true-stress range, rather than multiple distinct hardening stages.
The caption states the tests are on annealed 8Al steels tensile deformed at an initial strain rate of 5 × 10^-4 s^-1.
The caption gives the 8Al composition as Fe–30.5Mn–8.0Al–1.2C (wt.%), which is not printed anywhere on the plot itself.

The citing text states the 8Al steels exhibit less hardening capacity than the 2Al steels at early stages of deformation (2Al steels ~2.6 GPa; 8Al steels ~2 GPa) — the 2Al data are not shown in this figure.
The citing text states that the short-annealed 8Al steel exhibits greater hardening than the long-annealed 8Al steel.
The citing text attributes the modified strain hardening behaviour to the high Al content (8 wt.%) in Fe–Mn–Al–C steels.
